scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && vitest run
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w shared && npm run db:seed -w backend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
